ApiSamples.Notes: Request fields are multipart/form-data parts; filters is a JSON string. Responses are computed over the products in sample_products.json. Every request also needs the header Authorization: Bearer <Keycloak access token>.

Sample.name: F02 category - list of ids (match any)
F11 product_type - id and name mixed (match any)
F14 seller - both seller ids (match any)
F23 currency - list SAR or USD
F57 filters with no matching product
F58 price range + sort by price asc
F59 price range + sort by price desc
E03 filters is a JSON array, not an object
E04 empty filters object (nothing else sent)
E07 keyword filter - number instead of string
E11 numeric filter - unsupported range operator
E12 numeric filter - empty range object
E13 numeric filter - string inside range
E14 numeric filter - list with a string
E17 first invalid key is reported (valid + invalid)
